title: IAPQB Reports: how organisations handle AI at work
description:
Research reports by the International AI Practice Qualification Board (IAPQB). Each report sets out a problem, the documented cases behind it (court decisions, regulators' documents, standards, company statements and peer-reviewed studies) and what practitioners now do about it. Every source is opened and checked before publication. Report 01 is a data report on AI-related private qualifications in South Korea, with its data and aggregation script.

Web versions: https://iapqb.org/research/
